name: p15_forkfree_probe
title: Biohub P15 ForkFree Probe
purpose: DIAGNOSTIC, NOT A LEVER. Emits P9 (LB 0.925) with BIOHUB_OUTPUT_SAFE_DIVISIONS=0, i.e. a FORK-FREE graph. The official summarise() drops the division term entirely when a submission contains no divisions (score = edge_jaccard if not has_divisions), so the returned public score IS our pure adjusted edge Jaccard. divJ then follows by subtraction from P9: divJ = (0.925 - probe) / 0.1. Expected to score BELOW 0.925; that is correct and is the point. Source of the mechanism: Kaggle discussion/734192 (Arul Prasad S P), host-verified reading of the scorer. Reference decomposition: mikelou1 0.928 = adj_edge 0.898 + 0.030 (divJ 0.30), so a 0.953 team needs adj_edge ~0.923.
provenance: Derived from p9_coupled_division (LB 0.925) by a single env flip. Identical base notebook, identical datasets, identical division transplant code -- the ONLY difference is that the safe-division proposer is switched off, so no fork can be emitted. The bijection in motion_relink_edges already forbids out-degree 2, so this flag is the sole remaining fork source.
